fields.note: The board also exposes appliedFacets[workerSubType] (Job Type: 'Regular'), which is a contract type rather than an employment type.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: CXS returns locations only as a nested locationMainGroup facet with no flat facet ids, so location is matched locally against locationsText.

notes: VMware has no careers site of its own: careers.vmware.com no longer answers (TCP timeouts) and vmware.com/careers routes through broadcom.com/jobs to Broadcom's Workday board tenant 'broadcom' / site 'External_Career' (389 postings at capture). The board is parent-wide and exposes no VMware facet, so membership is decided by the structured hiringOrganization.name field (VMware legal employer) after enumerating the board, not by the keyword search. CXS POST body: appliedFacets + searchText + limit/offset; facets published are timeType, workerSubType, jobFamilyGroup and locationMainGroup — the seed's 'appliedFacets[jobFamily]'/'workplaceType'/'locationCountry' parameters do not exist on this board and were removed. Keyword search is fuzzy: searchText='vmware' returns 41 rows, only some of which are VMware-employer postings.
evidence: https://broadcom.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/broadcom/External_Career/jobs POST {"searchText":"vmware"} -> total 41 (fuzzy keyword search, no VMware facet)
